From: James E Fleming <revfleming@sbcglobal.net>
Sent: Monday, June 25, 2018 5:43 PM
To: editpg <editpg@freepress.com>
Cc: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>; Sipple, George <gsipple@freepress.com>; Windsor, Shawn <swindsor@freepress.com>; Seidel, Jeff <jseidel@freepress.com>; WDIV Local 4 <sports@clickondetroit.com>; Bill Schuette <miag@michigan.gov>
Subject: Fake Sport News 
 
 Perhaps Donald Trump is correct SOMETIMES about "FAKE NEWS" as I've noticed that many of the article about the Tigers are really just SCAMS that the Detroit Free Press Sport writers appears to be a huge part of. For example, the Detroit Tigers are really NOT competitive with major league teams, except those who roosters are loaded with Double-A players like the Tigers are.

I really believe that the Michigan Attorney should investigate and bring charges against the Detroit Tigers and MLB as they allow teams who're not competitive to charge the fans major league fees for minor league performance by minor league players. If the Reporters were really honest they would point out how much the fans pay to see many many of the Tigers players performing in Toledo and Double A.
Yet the Free Press and Sport Reporters on TV appears to be just part of this scam as they ALMOST NEVER stick their necks out and write the REAL TRUTH.

Consumers are being scammed by the Detroit Tigers and nobody with the ability to do something about it. I've watched other scams by the Tigers last for TWENTY where they "CLAIM" to be rebuilding. Don't believe me? Then go back to 1952 and see how many years the Detroit Tigers have been just plain LOUSY but management is still raking in MILLIONS in profit.
